scope: Budapest ramen discovery candidates, including broader restaurants and unresolved delivery brands. Not a verified list of active ramen shops.

limitations: Maps results are ranked and geographically biased; this pass does not prove citywide completeness.

Maps price brackets were deliberately not collected as ramen price ranges.
No public listings are added by this discovery file.
